title: UK Postcode Walking Route Planner
description: Request a walking route between two UK postcode representative locations; verify access and conditions locally.
summary_sentence: A postcode route starts and ends at representative provider locations, not necessarily the desired doorsteps.
quick_answer: The tool resolves two postcodes via postcodes.io and requests a pedestrian route from Valhalla. Postcode locations are representative, route data can be incomplete, and a route may be unavailable or unsuitable.
steps_intro: Britain runs on postcodes; walks should too. Two codes, one route:

body.t: Request an initial walking route, then check entrances and current access.
A routed estimate between postcode points cannot verify an estate-agent claim for a particular property.
The reported time is an estimate, not a personalised or guaranteed exercise duration.
Visitors can request a route between two postcode points and confirm the actual start, end and access locally.
South-bank to north-bank postcodes route via the nearest bridge — the walk the map insists on, not the swim the straight line suggests.
The route uses representative postcode coordinates returned by the provider. They need not identify the desired front doors.

faq: Does the route use footpaths?
It requests pedestrian routing on mapped paths and streets. Access, closures and completeness are not guaranteed; check official local information.
Is the time realistic?
It is a routing estimate at walking speeds. Your own pace — measured by the Walking Pace Calculator — refines it; hills refine it further.
Does the route include live traffic?
No, and pedestrians are mercifully indifferent to most of it. Closures and works are the walker's version; the data snapshot is the limit.
Why is road distance longer than straight-line?
A route may detour around barriers, but this tool’s result is only a routing estimate between representative postcode points. Check access and conditions locally.
Can route results change over time?
New paths and corrected data change routes over seasons. Re-plan a standing walk occasionally.
Partial postcodes?
The postcode lookup expects a postcode resolved by postcodes.io. Partial district codes are not guaranteed to resolve.
Outside the UK?
This page is postcode-shaped for Britain. The Walking Route Planner takes any start and finish worldwide.
The route crosses private land.
Mapped paths can include permissive routes that close seasonally. Signs on the ground outrank the plan; divert and re-plan beyond the gate.
Walking time feels optimistic.
The displayed time is the router’s estimate. This workspace does not let you replace it with your own pace; allow for terrain, breaks and conditions.
Can I plan from a postcode to a place?
Postcode to postcode is the shape; for a named place as the other end, the Walking Route Planner takes free-form starts.
